meta.name: Sector Casebook
meta.note: Sector index for the Industry Deep-Dive Track (Appendix D). Pack ids match data/packs.json. Case codes use the three-letter sector code: <CODE>-<TYPE>-<SEED>, for example MFG-B-7K3Q. Type X is the sector capstone.

A.name: Walkthrough
A.goal: Coverage: find the planted issues across the site

B.name: Records Trail
B.goal: Scope accuracy: trace the records and define what is affected

C.name: Root Cause Interview
C.goal: Cause depth: interview staff and reach a system cause

D.name: Change Under Review
D.goal: Completeness: assess a proposed change for risks, controls, and records

E.name: Complaint Response
E.goal: Containment and response: limit exposure and answer the customer

F.name: Pressure Decision
F.goal: Decision quality: choose and justify a response under schedule pressure

X.name: Sector Capstone
X.goal: Mixed: three or more case types in one visit

branches.name: Evidence
branches.builds: Noticing and collecting relevant evidence; ignoring noise

branches.name: Mapping
branches.builds: Linking evidence to the right requirement

branches.name: Cause
branches.builds: Moving from symptom to system cause

branches.name: Judgment
branches.builds: Decisions under pressure, including speaking up

reflectionQuestions: Which evidence from the casebook would you now look for first at your own workplace, and why?
Describe one system condition in your own area that could allow an issue like the ones you investigated. What control would prevent it?
What will you do differently in your role in the next month as a result of this sector track?
badgeCriteria: Instructor review of the capstone findings (and, preferably, a short oral or on-the-job demonstration)

sectors.name: Healthcare and clinical services (management system topics only)
